annotations.title: Reconcile what landed on a payment run

description: Reconciles each released payment in a run with what landed: amount sent, amount landed, settlement time, proof reference, the official rate with a Rate Receipt, realised all-in cost in percent and in the sent currency, and position inside, above or below the assessment range. The same proof reference is rejected the second time. dry_run: true validates and writes nothing. A payment with no assessment is flagged no_evidence. A router key is required except for pr_sample. Never sends money.

access_key.description: A router key (rk_...), if not sent as a Bearer header.

payments.description: [{ payment_id, sent_amount, landed_amount, settled_at?, proof_ref, source? }]. proof_ref is an MT103 reference, a transaction hash or a provider reference.
